notes: §2002:12.3.4.9.2 GR2: sequential organization identifies a record by the predecessor-successor relationship set when it is placed. Records written ZZZZ, AAAA, X"410A4220" read back through ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL in that order (not collating order), the third unchanged (a record, not a line): SEQ 1 00 ZZZZ, SEQ 2 00 AAAA, SEQ 3 00 SAME, SEQ 4 10 (§2002:9.1.12.3). run at --std 2002 on the pinned build: exit 0, 6 lines equal the derived .out (MATCH). Built from the reader's org_default.cob and seq_bytes.cob.
